fundamentals.name: Airbnb, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and returns are tempered by a high valuation and a recent earnings miss.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 17.9% YoY and analyst estimates for 18.2% this quarter and 25.2% this fiscal year.
High gross margin of 82.9% and profit margin of 19.9%.
Significant free cash flow of $3.19B TTM.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target of $156.51.
negatives: Last quarter's EPS missed estimates by 14.1%.
Trailing P/E of 33.02 and PEG ratio of 1.24 suggest a premium valuation.
Operating margin of 3.2% is relatively low compared to gross margin.
Quick ratio of 0.74 indicates potential short-term liquidity concerns.

news.paragraph: Airbnb's stock has seen recent gains, outperforming the market and attracting investor attention, with one report highlighting its position in Jeff Bezos's portfolio. Analysts note a GF Value suggesting the stock may be undervalued relative to its current price. While recent earnings showed a slight miss, the company is expected to see significant growth in the current quarter and fiscal year.
